dataset: make_classification(5000,20,5 informative,5 redundant,weights .8/.2,class_sep=1.0), per-seed split 60/20/20 stratified
primary_metric: mean average precision over clean, 10%, 30%, 50% MCAR test conditions, equal weight; paired within-seed candidate minus fixed-median matched MLP
candidate: MLP [40,64,32,1], BN/ReLU, dropout .2, Adam 1e-3, batch256; per-row mask rate Uniform[0,.4], missing features replaced by trainable scalars initialized to train medians; mask concatenated; BCE; max80 epochs, early stop validation AP patience10
primary_control: same architecture, initialization, data, augmentation masks and validation stopping; fill scalars frozen at train medians
pass_rule: candidate paired mean delta >= +0.01 AP versus fixed-median MLP and positive delta on at least 2 of 3 seeds; validation-selected architecture and optimizer frozen
held_out_policy: No test metrics may be computed/read until this file is written. Each test split is evaluated once; no tuning afterward.
